name: investment-analyst
description: Sweden-first equity research on free, keyless primary sources — no API keys, no paid feeds, no identifying requests. Enforces provenance, temporal validity, source independence and the decision's own arithmetic in code rather than instructions. Plain-language answers; full evidence and valuation build on request. TTM engine, valuation gate, validated decision record with enforced conviction caps, falsifiable thesis ledger, portfolio review, 1060-test regression suite covering the instruction layer as well as the code. Screens Nasdaq Stockholm, Copenhagen and Helsinki plus Oslo Børs; Sweden remains the default.
